info.description: Local bearer-authenticated browser adapter. Normative semantics: docs/ui.md, docs/diagnostics-ui.md, docs/investigation-ui.md and docs/query-ui.md. Embedded core schemas preserve authoritative validation semantics with local schema references; metadata literal references remain unchanged.

200.description: Already terminal; actual final state retained.

sessionBearer.description: Process-scoped random token from the launcher URL fragment; never a URL query parameter.

effective_limits.description: Effective execution limits; explicit durable jobs may use up to one hour. Foreground request admission retains the separate 300-second limits definition.

QueryTarget.description: Launcher-granted Grafana alias only, separate from diagnostic targets.

target_id.description: The selected diagnostic, saved-query or collection alias; null for other operations. Never substituted for root_id.

DiagnosticTarget.description: Only launcher-granted alias IDs. Labels equal the alias ID; no configured destination, path, process selector or CA is exposed.

DiagnosticLimits.description: Timeout 1–60000ms; output uses the existing core request bounds 1024–2097152 bytes and normalizes to the effective diagnostics ceiling of 16384 bytes before fingerprinting/dispatch. Omitted concurrency normalizes to 2; null is invalid.

DiagnosticSubmission.description: Only the fixed connectivity v1 pack and a granted target alias. root_id is forbidden even when null. Pack input omissions normalize to capture_body=false,on_failure=continue. No endpoint/path/PID/trust override exists. The submission fingerprint includes operation/version, alias, normalized pack input and every effective core limit.

original_base64.description: Canonical RFC 4648 base64 with at most 32768 decoded bytes; exact bytes and digest remain runtime checks.
